description: Sets up two subdomains of the customer's domain for UserPath email campaigns: news.<domain> sends them (a DKIM key, and a CNAME that makes it its own bounce domain) and link.<domain> carries their links (a CNAME to the click-tracking host, which serves it over HTTPS). Apply it at the domain the subdomains go under. Both CNAMEs must not be proxied.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector UserPath's mail (SparkPost) generated for this domain (letters and digits, like scph1026); dkimkey: that selector's 2048-bit RSA public key, base64 (the p= of the DKIM record)
